message.content:
- Hero is minimal: headline "JETOUR MONGOLIA", subheadline "Your Next Adventure Starts Here", + 2 CTAs ("Explore Models", "Book Test Drive").  
- Sections are well-spaced: distinct, generous white space between content blocks (e.g., hero, gradient, dark blue, and footer sections).  
- Premium automotive feel: clean typography, high-quality car imagery, and sleek color palette (dark blue, white) evoke sophistication.  
- Overall design balances simplicity with luxury, aligning with premium automotive branding.
